title: catananche lutea subsp. carpholepis
intro: Catananche lutea subsp. carpholepis, commonly known as yellow kniff or yellow thorny kniff, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Catananche lutea subsp. carpholepis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to possess hepatoprotective and immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
